notes: §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR12: 'Identifier-1 must not be reference modified.' ProcedureTableBuilder.AddDebugDataTarget, which FinalizeDebug reaches for both the identifier-1 and ALL REFERENCES OF identifier-1 operands, refuses COBOL6334 a refModPart on the operand or on any qualifier before it records a target. Probed at 85: S (1:2), ALL REFERENCES OF S (2:), the table element F1 (1:1) and the degenerate S ( ) are each refused COBOL6334; the bare S is accepted and fires after MOVE "QQ" TO S(2:2) with DEBUG-CONTENTS AQQDEF; at 2002 and 2023 the statement is COBOL0902. The witness refuses WS-A (1:2).

next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 must not be reference modified."; 2023: "No USE FOR DEBUGGING: the 2023 USE statement rules cover only exceptions, EC/EO and USE BEFORE REPORTING.". No 2023 clause holds the Debug feature. The 2023 USE rules have no FOR DEBUGGING form; SR-9's identifier-1 is a report group, another subject. The restriction goes with the feature.
